texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]已经定位了[From.GetName]上层大气层中异动的根源。令人吃惊的是，那不是一艘躲在云层里的舰船，而是一只幼年变形虫，而它的母亲则不知所踪。

我们无法得知这个幼体是如何与它的母亲和同类分离的，但有一点可以确定：它看上去已经对[Root.GetName]产生了印刻效应。当船员们结束了对[From.GetName]的调查之后，他们发现这只变形虫在跟踪他们。显然它很难被甩掉，而且[Root.GetLeaderName]对这只幼体的决心很是欣赏。

我们的科学专员建议允许这只变形虫一直跟随我们的船只，他坚信我们能从中学到更多关于变形虫的知识。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has located the source of the movement in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName]. Surprisingly, there was no ship hidden in the clouds, but rather a young Space Amoeba, its mother nowhere to be seen.

There is no way of knowing how this juvenile was separated from its mother or others of its kind, but one thing is certain: it appears to have imprinted on the [Root.GetName]. As the crew completed their survey of [From.GetName], they found that the Amoeba was following them. It has proven difficult to shake, and [Root.GetLeaderName] has taken quite a shine to the youngster's determination.

Our Science Officer suggests allowing the juvenile to follow the vessel, certain we may learn more about Space Amoebas in the process.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]已经定位了[From.GetName]上层大气层中异动的根源。令人吃惊的是，那不是一艘躲在云层里的舰船，而是某种温驯的外星生命体。尽管有着惊人的体型，这只被[Root.GetName]船员称为太空变形虫的生物似乎还处于幼年期。

我们无法得知这个幼体是如何与它的同类分离的，但有一点可以确定：它看上去已经对[Root.GetName]产生了印刻效应。当船员们结束了对[From.GetName]的调查之后，他们发现这只变形虫在跟踪他们。显然它很难被甩掉，而且[Root.GetLeaderName]对这只幼体的决心很是欣赏。

我们的科学专员建议允许这只变形虫一直跟随我们的船只，他坚信我们能从中学到更多关于变形虫的知识。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has located the source of the movement in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName]. Surprisingly, there was no ship hidden in the clouds, but rather a docile alien lifeform. Despite its impressive size, the creature, which the [Root.GetName] crew have dubbed a Space Amoeba, appears to be a juvenile.

There is no way of knowing how this juvenile was separated from its others of its kind, but one thing is certain: it appears to have imprinted on the [Root.GetName]. As the crew completed their survey of [From.GetName], it found that the creature was following them. It has proven difficult to shake, and [Root.GetLeaderName] has taken quite a shine to the juvenile's determination.

Our Science Officer suggests allowing the juvenile to follow the vessel, certain we may learn more about the species in the process.

label.zh: 绝对不行。继续尝试甩掉它。
label.en: Out of the question. Just keep avoiding it.

label.zh: 我们当然可以深入研究它。准备进行解剖。
label.en: We can certainly study it. Order a dissection.

texts.zh:
前段时间加入我们舰队的变形虫幼体现在看来已经完全成年了。尽管已经成长为了一位引人注目的大姑娘，她对那艘在自己被困[From.From.GetName]之时给了她一个新家的科研船还是忠心耿耿。

与舰队共处的岁月让她展现出了不同于野生变形虫的适应性行为，使得她在战场上成为了一个远比其同类更为强大的战力。在整个[Root.Owner.GetName]，她的身影已经成为了一个代表[Root.Owner.GetAdj]精神的吉祥物。

只剩下一个问题：我们应该为她取个什么名字？
texts.en:
The Amoeba juvenile that joined our fleet some time ago appears to have reached full maturity. Now an impressive adult, she is no less loyal to the ships that gave her a new home when she was stranded on [From.From.GetName].

Her time spent with the fleet appears to have encouraged adaptive behaviors not typically found in wild Space Amoebas, making her a more formidable presence on the battlefield than others of her kind. Across [Root.Owner.GetName], her image has become something of a mascot for the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] spirit.

Only one question remains: what should we name her?

label.zh: 这些名字矬爆了，我们得想个更好的。
label.en: These are all terrible. We should think of something better.

texts.zh: 吉祥物怎么能没有名字？我们必须要给我们的外星朋友起个配得上她的名字。
texts.en: What is a mascot without a name? We must devise a moniker worthy of our amoeboid ally.

label.zh: 这些名字矬爆了，我们得想个更好的。
label.en: These are all terrible. We should think of something better.

texts.zh:
我们能够突破时间和空间的界限，以超过光的速度旅行。可是我们却没办法定好一个变形虫的名字。

这是我们最后的机会。
texts.en:
We have developed the ability to break the boundaries of space and time, to travel faster than the speed of light. Yet we cannot decide upon a name for this amoeba.

This is our last chance.

label.en: Enough! Just call it ''Fluffy'' and be done with it!

texts.zh:
研究人员汇报道，先前在[From.From.GetName]发现的落单幼年变形虫已经不再跟随我们的科研船了。在跟随我们的科研船几周之后，变形虫幼体据称通过某种生物超空间驱动机能进入了一条超空间航道。也许它认出了那里的地形，或许它感应到了同类，又或者它只是厌倦了追随我们的船只。

尽管我们的舰船遵循指令没有和变形虫幼体进行互动，被动扫描还是为我们带来了一些有关这只生物的生理学发现。
texts.en:
Researchers report that the lost Amoeba juvenile found near [From.From.GetName] is no longer following our science fleet. After doing so for the past several weeks, the juvenile reportedly entered a hyperlane via some biological hyperdrive capacity. Perhaps it recognized the terrain, or sensed others of its kind. Or perhaps it simply tired of chasing after our ship.

Though our ships refrained from interacting with the juvenile as instructed, passive scans have led to some revelations regarding the creature's physiology.

texts.zh:
对幼年变形虫的解剖已经完成。尽管大部分机体组织在捕获过程中被摧毁了，对残骸进行的外星生物学研究依然揭示出其优异的再生能力。

简而言之，这生物的组织再生并不仅仅通过细胞复制进行，还依靠一种硅基细菌辅助其器官组织重构。

对该细菌的遗传信息进行适当的修改后，我们或能利用这种自我修复能力开发出一种船体自愈矩阵，不过这过程相当缓慢。
texts.en:
The dissection of the Amoeba juvenile has completed. While large portions of the body were destroyed during the creature's pacification, xenobiological analysis of the remains have revealed remarkable regenerative qualities.

Simply put, the creature regenerates not only via cell-replication, but with the assistance of a silicon-based bacteria that reconstructs organic tissue.

With some modifications to this bacteria's genetic information, we could potentially harness its regenerative capacity in order to devise a self-repairing hull matrix, gradual though the process may be.

texts.zh:
对幼年变形虫的解剖已经完成。尽管大部分机体组织在捕获过程中被摧毁了，对残骸进行的外星生物学研究依然揭示出其优异的再生能力。

这些发现和我们之前研究的变形虫-硅基细菌共生关系所带来的组织修复能力原理一致，我们早已将其应用到了船体再生技术上。
texts.en:
The dissection of the Amoeba juvenile has completed. While large portions of the body were destroyed during the creature's pacification, xenobiological analysis of the remains have revealed remarkable regenerative qualities.

These are in line with our previous research regarding the symbiotic relationship between Space Amoebas and the silicon-based bacteria that restore their damaged tissue, which we have already repurposed into regenerative hull technology.

texts.zh: 由于我们未能积极采取措施做好解剖幼体变形虫的准备工作，它似乎是已经逃脱了。传感器显示几个小时前它使用了某种生物超空间驱动机能，脱离了我们的掌控。
texts.en: Pending our lack of initiative in securing the Amoeba juvenile for dissection, it appears to have escaped. Sensors report the juvenile engaged some kind of biological hyperdrive and disappeared off the grid, just hours ago.

texts.zh:
[From.Fleet.GetName]的死讯很快传遍了[Root.GetName]，但没有任何人比科学专员[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]更加痛心。是[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetSheHe]第一个发现了迷失无助的变形虫幼体，并见证了它在自己[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetHisHer]温柔的教导下逐渐步入成年。

现在，失去了[From.Fleet.GetName]无言的陪伴，科学专员[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]也许再也回不到以前的状态了。
texts.en:
News of the death of [From.Fleet.GetName] has rippled through the [Root.GetName], though none have been as affected as Science Officer [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]. It was [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetSheHe] who first discovered the Space Amoeba as a lost and helpless juvenile, and watched the creature grow to full maturity under [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetHisHer] own gentle guidance.

Now, without [From.Fleet.GetName]'s silent companionship, Officer [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName] may never be the same again.

texts.zh:
[Root.Fleet.GetName]的死讯很快传遍了[Root.Owner.GetName]，但没有任何人比科学专员[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]更加痛心。是[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetSheHe]第一个发现了迷失无助的变形虫幼体，并见证了它在[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetHisHer]自己温柔的教导下逐渐步入成年。

News of the death of [Root.Fleet.GetName] has rippled through the [Root.Owner.GetName], though none have been as affected as Science Officer [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]. It was [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetSheHe] who first discovered the Space Amoeba as a lost and helpless juvenile, and watched the creature grow to full maturity under [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetHisHer] own gentle guidance.

Now, without [Root.Fleet.GetName]'s silent companionship, Officer [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName] may never be the same again.

texts.zh: [Root.Fleet.GetName]的死讯很快传遍了[Root.Owner.GetName]。这只变形虫一直以来都是我国的忠实伴侣。不过，我们的死灵法师在噩耗传来之后异常活跃，现在已经为我们悲痛的国民带来了解决方案。他们对方案没有细说，不过却坚称一定能让[Root.Fleet.GetName]重新回到我们身边。
texts.en: News of the death of [Root.Fleet.GetName] has rippled through the [Root.Owner.GetName]. The amoeba has been a constant companion for our nation for a long time now. However, our necromancers have been unusually active ever since the fateful news came and have now come with a solution to our grieving nation. They won't explain how but they say that they can bring [Root.Fleet.GetName] back to us.

texts.zh: [reanimated_amoeba.Fleet.GetName]活过来了？至少她已经可以活动了。尽管我们确实不清楚[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]到底干了什么，但多亏了他们的极度绝望和对科学的疯狂，我们又可以和亲爱的虫虫比翼齐飞了。
texts.en: [reanimated_amoeba.Fleet.GetName] lives?! Or at least she moves. We do not truly understand what [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName] did, but thanks to the depths of their despair and madness of their science, our beloved amoeba flies with us once more.

texts.zh: [reanimated_amoeba.Fleet.GetName]活过来了？至少她已经可以活动了。尽管我们确实不清楚死灵法师到底干了什么，但多亏了他们的极度绝望和对科学的疯狂，我们又可以和亲爱的虫虫比翼齐飞了。
texts.en: [reanimated_amoeba.Fleet.GetName] lives?! Or at least she moves. We do not truly understand what our necromancers have done, but thanks to the depths of their despair and madness of their science, our beloved amoeba flies with us once more.

texts.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]上正在到处播放我们指挥官们带来的振奋人心的消息：我们收养的太空变形虫，[lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName]，已经一百岁高龄了。

虽然对我们来说一百岁已是期颐之年，但是我们的变形虫朋友似乎不仅未显老态。事实上，我们的舰队报告称[lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName]的战斗力与日俱增。时至今日，即便我们最精锐的战舰在面对[lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName]时也不得不有所忌惮了。她优美而强健的身姿已经成为战场上鼓舞[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]士气的一道亮丽的风景线。
texts.en:
Exciting news from our fleet commanders is being broadcasted over [Root.Capital.GetName]. Our adopted Space Amoeba, [lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName], has just reached an impressive one hundred years of age.

Though a grizzled centenarian, it appears age has proven no impediment to our amoeboid ally. In fact, our fleets report [lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName]'s presence on the battlefield has only grown more formidable over time. [lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName] has become a force even the best-equipped battleship would have trouble contending with. Seeing her billowing flagella enter a system never fails to lift the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] spirit.

texts.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种全新的、美丽的、神奇的太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。

我们应该避免与它们接触，从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]远距离观察这些生物。
texts.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, wondrous, forms of spaceborne life.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following an analyst's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

We should leave it be and remotely monitor the creature and its kin from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种全新的、骇人的太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。

终结这些憎恶异形苟活于世的苦难应该没有什么害处。

既是为了科学，也可以是为了其他什么。
texts.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, horrifying lifeforms.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following an analyst's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

There would be little harm in putting the monstrosities out of their misery.

For science, or some equivalent.

texts.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。

这些生物对[Root.Owner.GetAdj]舰船表现出了敌意的行为，但我们授权进一步的研究。
texts.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are spaceborne forms of life.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following a tactician's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

The creature displays aggressive behavior towards [Root.Owner.GetAdj] ships but further study might be warranted.

texts.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遭遇的是一种从未见过的太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。

虽然它脾气很坏，但是想进一步研究也不是不行的——我们可以从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]远距离观察它们。
texts.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, spaceborne lifeforms.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following an analyst's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

Despite its apparent orneriness, further study is warranted - we can remotely monitor the creature and its kin from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。
texts.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are spaceborne forms of life.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following an analyst's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

texts.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种全新的太空生命。

尽管个体体型远远大于[Root.Owner.GetAdj]的护卫舰，这些“太空变形虫”兽群相对于我们的舰队依然弱小不堪。
texts.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, spaceborne lifeforms.

While significantly larger than a [Root.Owner.GetAdj] Corvette, these "Space Amoeba" herds are minuscule next to our full corpus.

texts.zh:
我们的舰队此前遭遇到的实体是一种新发现的太空生命形式。

由于最初对传感器数据的粗略误读，我们很快就给它们起昵称为“太空变形虫”，实际上这种生物比[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]护卫舰的平均尺寸还要大。
texts.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, spaceborne lifeforms.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following a gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] corvette.

texts.zh: 若得以安抚，它们可以成为我们种荚的理想携带者。
texts.en: If pacified, they could prove themselves ideal carriers for our Seed Pods.

texts.zh: 除了最年轻的个体外，其他所有个体都伴随有通过RNA掺杂分泌物控制的准独立生物体。这些“鞭毛”以复杂的攻击模式进行攻击，因此尽管它们看似缺乏智慧，但“太空变形虫”却是非常熟练的自然捕食者。
texts.en: All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent organisms controlled via RNA-laced secretions. These "flagella" strike in complex attack patterns, so despite their apparent lack of sapience, "Space Amoeba" are highly adept natural predators.

label.zh: 研究或许可以加速将来的消灭行动。
label.en: A study may expedite future extermination.

texts.zh:
太空变形虫——这个昵称现在已经传遍了[Root.Capital.GetName]的大街小巷——是一种独居的生物。成年的太空变形虫身边总会伴随着一种被称为鞭毛的半独立生物。鞭毛由变形虫自行生成，并通过分泌液态RNA来进行控制。

我们一度误以为这就是太空变形虫的幼体，但其实这些鞭毛并不含有繁殖器官，每个鞭毛更像是变形虫向外延伸的肢体。这些鞭毛可以在一定范围内离开主体并攻击敌人，但每隔一段时间就需要回返主体内进行重构。

太空变形虫厚皮的再生特性，或鞭毛的精巧的运动模式都有着潜在的军事应用价值。
texts.en:
The Space Amoebas - the nickname now lovingly popularized on [Root.Capital.GetName] - are solitary animals, when left to their own devices. All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent organisms, dubbed flagella, seemingly spawned by the Amoeba and programmed through liquid, RNA-laced secretions to do the bidding of the host.

Initially assumed to be young Space Amoebas, the flagella do not seem to factor into any reproductive mechanics, each individual flagellum instead operating solely as a disconnected limb for its host Amoeba. These flagella are capable of manipulating and even attacking objects in an impressive yet restricted range around the host, periodically returning to lodge inside the host Amoeba's body for re-programming.

There are potential military applications to be found in the regenerative properties of the amoeba's thick hide, or in the flagella's graceful patterns of movement.

太空变形虫——这个昵称在这些生物被发现之后，在[Root.Capital.GetName]彻底火起来了。它们是一种独自生活的生物。成年的太空变形虫的身边会伴随着一种被称为鞭毛的半自主生物。鞭毛是由太空变形虫所生成，并通过液态RNA分泌物来控制。

鞭毛一度被误会为太空变形虫的幼体，但其实它们并不含有繁殖器官，每个鞭毛更像是太空变形虫主体身上断开的肢体一般。这些鞭毛可以在离开主体的一定范围内攻击敌人，但每隔一段时间就需要回返太空变形虫体内被重新编译。

texts.zh: 一只太空变形虫通常伴随着一些半自主的鞭节，用于防御以及移动物体。变形虫与其鞭节并不共享意志，而是前者使用一种带有核糖核酸的分泌物来为后者编程，指引其完成较为复杂的任务。
texts.en: A Space Amoeba is usually accompanied by a handful of semi-independent flagella used for defense and object manipulation. The Amoeba and its flagella do not share a mind, the former instead using RNA-laced secretions to program the latter for the execution of tasks of middling complexity.

texts.zh:
太空变形虫——当为这种外星生物运用合适的分类方法来确定学名太过麻烦时，这个名称就被[Root.GetSpeciesName]的普罗大众沿用下来——是一种在太空中独居的生物。除了最幼小的那些个体以外，所有我们收集到的样本都拥有半独立的鞭毛和其他有机质，它们由变形虫本身产生并在液态的RNA分泌物中被设计，以方便宿主操纵。这些鞭毛可以被宿主操纵，甚至可以攻击宿主周围巨大但有限范围内的物体，并会定期的缩回变形虫体内，并被重新设计。

太空变形虫厚皮的再生特性，或鞭毛的精巧的运动模式都有着潜在的军事应用价值。
texts.en:
The Space Amoebas - the name has stuck as the pronunciation of the proper xeno-taxonomic denominator is too unwieldy for the average [Root.GetSpeciesName] - are solitary animals, when left to their own devices. All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent flagella, organisms spawned by the Amoeba and programmed through liquid, RNA-laced secretions to do the bidding of the host. These flagella are capable of manipulating and even attacking objects in an impressive yet restricted range around the host, periodically returning to lodge inside the host Amoeba's body for re-programming.

There are potential military applications to be found in the regenerative properties of the amoeba's thick hide, or in the flagella's graceful patterns of movement.

texts.zh:
处于太空变形虫群附近时，停止舰只反应核心的某些特定辐射的排放似乎可以避免将其激怒。

由于这一举措，他们已不再将我们视为威胁，我们也因此得以近距离对其进行观察。
texts.en:
Temporarily refraining from venting certain emissions from our vessels' reactor cores while in the immediate vicinity of Space Amoebas flocks seems to be enough to not arouse their ire.

With this new protocol in place they no longer pose a threat, and we have been able to study them at close range.

texts.zh: 尽管它们是肉食性的，但我们的研究人员开发的肉质球果对它们的口味也很有吸引力。
texts.en: While they are mostly carnivorous, the meaty, bulbous fruits our researchers developed appeal to their tastes.

texts.zh: 安排一个科学部门收集并整理太空变形虫的相关数据。
texts.en: Task a science department with collecting and collating data relating to the Space Amoebas.

texts.zh: 不知为何，我们的舰队似乎会激怒太空变形虫。要是能够确定其原因，也许就能降低变形虫的侵略性，甚至将我们的舰队从其感官中完全屏蔽。
texts.en: Something about our fleets seems to agitate the Space Amoebas. If we could somehow isolate what this something is, we could reduce Amoeba aggression or possibly completely mask our ships from their senses.

texts.zh: 我们决定用致命手段来提取迷途变形虫幼体的生物数据。我们将派人将其捕获，并解剖其遗骸。
texts.en: We have decided to extract biological data from the lost juvenile Space Amoeba by fatal means. We will send a task force to capture the creature, and dissect its remains.

texts.zh: 尽管我们确实不太清楚其中的门道，但在[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]的带领下，我们的死灵法师已经成功让本已逝世的变形虫重返世间了。
texts.en: We do not quite understand it but headed by [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName] our necromancers have set out to bring back our dearly departed amoeba.
